purpose: Specification for satellite-derived historical built-up change indicators
supporting_evidence: Infrastructure capacity and accessibility data, when available

built_up_classification.description: A documented classification identifying built-up pixels in each observation.

indicators.name: Built-up Area
indicators.description: Total mapped built-up area within the valid study-area observation.
indicators.interpretation: Measures mapped built-up extent, not population or infrastructure adequacy.

indicators.name: New Built-up Area
indicators.description: Area classified as non-built-up in the earlier observation and built-up in the later observation.
indicators.calculation: count(valid_pixels where earlier_class == 0 and later_class == 1) * pixel_area_m2 / 1000000
indicators.interpretation: Indicates mapped built-up gain between observations; classification errors can create false change.

indicators.name: Built-up Area Loss
indicators.description: Area classified as built-up in the earlier observation and non-built-up in the later observation.
indicators.calculation: count(valid_pixels where earlier_class == 1 and later_class == 0) * pixel_area_m2 / 1000000
indicators.interpretation: Indicates mapped built-up loss; it does not independently explain why the change occurred.

indicators.name: Net Built-up Change
indicators.description: Difference between later and earlier built-up area over comparable valid observations.
indicators.interpretation: Positive values indicate net mapped expansion; negative values indicate net mapped reduction.

indicators.name: Built-up Change Percentage
indicators.description: Percentage change in built-up area relative to the earlier observation.
validity_conditions: Earlier built-up area must be greater than zero.
Both observations must use comparable valid-data coverage.
indicators.interpretation: Do not calculate when earlier built-up area is zero.

patterns.description: New built-up development within or surrounded by previously developed areas.
New built-up development adjoining the previous built-up boundary.
New built-up development spatially separated from previous built-up areas.
Change in the spatial arrangement and connectivity of built-up patches.

requirements: Define neighbourhood and connectivity rules before analysis.
Document patch-size thresholds and distance parameters.
Do not assign arbitrary development-pattern labels.

quality_controls: Use a common valid-data mask for pixel-level change comparisons.
Verify raster dimensions, transforms, CRS and pixel alignment.
Do not interpret unavailable pixels as non-built-up.
Do not interpret missing evidence as zero growth.

infrastructure_demand_assessment.principle: Built-up expansion alone does not establish infrastructure shortage or demand.
